svg.title: Full metric dashboard for three candidate models
svg.desc: Three hand-drawn cards labelled model A, model B and model C, each listing five metrics with bars. Model A: accuracy 0.924, macro-F1 0.925, flip-rate 0.613, mean distance 0.187, severe errors 0.042. Model B: accuracy 0.907, macro-F1 0.908, flip-rate 0.000, mean distance 0.232, severe errors 0.051. Model C: accuracy 0.818, macro-F1 0.816, flip-rate 0.000, mean distance 0.289, severe errors 0.030. Accuracy and macro-F1 carry up arrows for higher is better; flip-rate, mean distance and severe errors carry down arrows.
